     Zoekt de countdown-afbeelding in de hero en legt de cijfers eroverheen.
     De afbeelding zelf voeg je in WordPress toe; deze snippet voegt geen afbeelding toe.
     Herkenning: alleen afbeeldingen met een bestandsnaam uit IMAGES hieronder
     (ook WordPress-varianten zoals -1024x1024 of .webp).
     Einddatum: END hieronder. Na afloop verdwijnen de cijfers vanzelf. -->

<style>
  .yh-cd-overlay { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; container-type: inline-size; z-index: 1; }
  .yh-cd-overlay .yh-cd__d {
    position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--yh-cd-angle, -12deg));

    font-family: 'Gilroy', Arial, sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
    font-style: normal !important;
    font-size: var(--yh-cd-size, 5.8cqw) !important;

  }
</style>

<script nowprocket>
(function () {
  var END = Date.parse('2026-12-01T00:00:00+01:00'); // = t/m 30 november, Nederlandse tijd

  // Per afbeelding: bestandsnaam (zonder extensie), posities van de vier tegels
  // in % van de afbeelding [links, boven], cijfergrootte (% van de breedte) en kanteling
  var IMAGES = [
    { file: 'Landingspagina-Joeri-countdown',
      pos: [[25.2, 56.6], [33.5, 54.8], [45.2, 52.2], [53.5, 50.5]],
      size: 5.8, angle: -12 },
    { file: 'joeri-staand-countdown',
      pos: [[39.0, 64.0], [47.5, 62.1], [59.4, 59.6], [67.7, 57.7]],
      size: 6.4, angle: -12 }
  ];

  // Exact deze bestandsnaam, eventueel met -1024x1024 en/of een andere extensie (.png, .webp, .png.webp)
  IMAGES.forEach(function (cfg) {
    cfg.re = new RegExp('/' + cfg.file + '(-\\d+x\\d+)?(\\.[a-z0-9]+)+(\\?|\\s|,|$)', 'i');
  });

  function findConfig(img) {
    var srcs = [img.currentSrc, img.src, img.srcset,

    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    if (pic) pic.querySelectorAll('source').forEach(function (s) {
      srcs.push(s.srcset, s.getAttribute('data-lazy-srcset'));
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < IMAGES.length; i++) {
      var re = IMAGES[i].re;
      if (srcs.some(function (u) { return u && re.test(u); })) return IMAGES[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function attach(img, cfg) {
    if (img.dataset.yhCd) return;
    img.dataset.yhCd = '1';

    // Bij <picture> komt de cijferlaag naast het picture-element, niet erin
    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    var parent = (pic || img).parentElement;
    if (getComputedStyle(parent).position === 'static') parent.style.position = 'relative';

    var box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'yh-cd-overlay';
    box.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-size', cfg.size + 'cqw');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-angle', cfg.angle + 'deg');
    var digits = cfg.pos.map(function (p) {
      var s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'yh-cd__d';
      s.style.left = p[0] + '%';
      s.style.top = p[1] + '%';
      box.appendChild(s);
      return s;
    });
    parent.appendChild(box);

    // Overlay exact over de afbeelding leggen, ook als de layout verandert
    function place() {
      var r = img.getBoundingClientRect(), pr = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
      box.style.left = (r.left - pr.left - parent.clientLeft) + 'px';
      box.style.top = (r.top - pr.top - parent.clientTop) + 'px';
      box.style.width = r.width + 'px';
      box.style.height = r.height + 'px';
    }
    place();
    img.addEventListener('load', place);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(place).observe(img);
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);

    function update() {
      var ms = END - Date.now();
      if (ms <= 0) { box.remove(); return; }
      var days = Math.min(99, Math.floor(ms / 864e5));
      var hours = Math.floor((ms % 864e5) / 36e5);
      var s = String(days).padStart(2, '0') + String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
      digits.forEach(function (el, i) { el.textContent = s[i]; });
      setTimeout(update, 60000 - (Date.now() % 60000));
    }
    update();
  }

  function init() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.images, function (img) {
      var cfg = findConfig(img);
      if (cfg) attach(img, cfg);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

<style>#yh-nav-root{display:none}</style>

<div id="yh-nav-root">
<style>
:root{--yh-black:#181818;--yh-beige:#F5F3EE;--yh-orange:#FF8657;--yh-grey:#666;--yh-white:#fff;--yh-gradient:linear-gradient(to right,#bc509b 0,#bc509b 20%,#e84985 20%,#e84985 40%,#ff665e 40%,#ff665e 60%,#ff8657 60%,#ff8657 80%,#ffb357 80%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-grad-s:linear-gradient(135deg,#bc509b 0,#e84985 30%,#ff665e 56%,#ff8657 78%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-radius:20px;--yh-nav-h:72px}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.yh-nav,.yh-nav *,.yh-mobile,.yh-mobile *{font-family:"Gilroy",sans-serif}
#yh-nav-root .yh-mega-item *,#yh-nav-root .yh-m-row *,#yh-nav-root .yh-link *,#yh-nav-root .yh-btn i,#yh-nav-root .yh-cart *{pointer-events:none}

/* bar */
.yh-nav{position:relative;z-index:1000;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--yh-beige);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-nav::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--yh-gradient)}
.yh-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;max-width:1440px;min-width:0;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;height:var(--yh-nav-h)}
.yh-logo{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;width:150px;height:34px;overflow:hidden;text-indent:-9999px;background:url("https://www.yourhosting.nl/wp-content/uploads/yh-logo.svg") no-repeat center/contain}
.yh-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex:1;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-menu>li{position:static}
.yh-menu>li.has-narrow{position:relative}
.yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:none}
.yh-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.yh-link:hover,.yh-link:hover .fa-chevron-down,.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true]{color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-link .fa-chevron-down{font-size:12px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .2s,color .15s}
.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--yh-orange)}

/* actions */
.yh-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto}
.yh-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:all .15s}
.yh-btn--ghost{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-btn--solid{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-orange);color:#fff}
.yh-btn--solid:hover{border-color:#ff7440;background:#ff7440;color:#fff}
.yh-cart{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.yh-cart:hover i{filter:brightness(.9)}
.yh-hamb{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-hamb i{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1}

/* mega */
.yh-mega{position:absolute;top:100%;z-index:1001;padding:32px;border-radius:var(--yh-radius);background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(24,24,24,.13);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-mega.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--wide{left:50%;width:calc(100vw - 48px);max-width:1024px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}
.yh-mega--wide.open{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--narrow{left:0;width:660px}
#mega-services .yh-mega-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,auto);grid-auto-flow:column;gap:16px 32px}
.yh-mega-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px 40px}
.yh-mega-col-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.yh-mega-heading{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:500!important;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-mega-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-mega-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;padding:4px;margin:-4px;border-radius:12px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:background .15s}
.yh-mega-item:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-mega-icon,.yh-m-rowicon,.yh-cart i{background:var(--yh-gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
.yh-mega-icon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;margin-top:2px;font-size:17px;text-align:center}
.yh-mega-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.yh-mega-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mega-sub{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--yh-grey)}

/* gepromoveerde rij */
.yh-promo{margin:0 0 26px}
.yh-promo-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-promo-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0;border:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.07);border-radius:16px;background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(24,24,24,.04);transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover{border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,134,87,.2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;margin:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:19px;background:var(--yh-grad-s);-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff;color:#fff}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-txt{flex:1;min-width:0}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-title{font-size:16px}
.yh-promo-arrow{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .15s,color .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover .yh-promo-arrow{color:var(--yh-orange);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* drawer */
.yh-overlay,.yh-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(24,24,24,.5);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s,visibility .25s}
.yh-overlay{z-index:1999}
.yh-scrim{z-index:999;transition:opacity .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-overlay.open,.yh-scrim.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.yh-mobile{position:fixed;top:7vh;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:400px;max-width:100vw;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:-12px 0 40px rgba(24,24,24,.18);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.yh-mobile.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.yh-mobile-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:42px;padding:3px 10px 3px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-m-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-m-title{display:none}
.yh-mobile-spacer{flex:1}
.yh-mobile-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-back i{font-size:15px}
.yh-mobile-back[hidden]{display:none}
.yh-mobile-close{padding:8px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.yh-mobile-foot{display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-mobile-foot .yh-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:12px 10px;font-size:15px}
.yh-m-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.yh-m-row:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05)}
.yh-m-rowicon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-m-row .yh-m-rowlabel{flex:1}
.yh-m-row .fa-chevron-right{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--yh-grey);color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-width:1200px){
.yh-bar{gap:18px;padding:0 16px}.yh-menu{gap:12px}.yh-link{font-size:15px}.yh-btn{gap:7px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px}.yh-logo{width:128px}.yh-promo-list{gap:12px}.yh-promo-item{padding:14px}.yh-mega--narrow{width:620px}
}
@media (min-width:1024px){.yh-mobile,.yh-overlay{display:none}}
@media (max-width:1023.98px){
.yh-bar{justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.yh-bar .yh-menu,.yh-actions .yh-btn,.yh-bar .yh-cart{display:none}
.yh-actions{order:2;gap:10px}
.yh-hamb{display:inline-flex;order:2}
/* hoofdmenu = root-lijst van de drawer */
.yh-mobile .yh-menu{display:block;flex:none;padding:2px 0}
.yh-mobile #yhLiDiensten{display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-link,.yh-mobile .yh-cart{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile .yh-link:hover,.yh-mobile .yh-cart:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile .yh-link .yh-m-rowicon,.yh-mobile .yh-cart i{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-link .fa-chevron-down,.yh-mobile .yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.yh-mobile .yh-cart .yh-sr-only{position:static;width:auto;height:auto;margin:0;overflow:visible;clip:auto;white-space:normal}
/* promo als 3 tiles bovenaan */
.yh-mobile .yh-promo{margin:0;padding:2px 0 8px}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo .yh-mega-heading{margin:0;padding:4px 18px;font-size:12px!important}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;padding:0 14px}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:10px 6px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-sub,.yh-mobile .yh-promo-arrow{display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-icon{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:16px}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-txt{flex:none;align-items:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-title{font-size:13px}
/* mega-panels = subpanels */
.yh-mobile .yh-mega{position:static;left:auto!important;width:auto;max-width:none;padding:6px 0;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega.yh-m-open{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega-grid,.yh-mobile .yh-mega-col-group,.yh-mobile #mega-services .yh-mega-list{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega-list{gap:0}
#yhPanels .yh-mega-heading{display:none}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem{gap:14px;padding:13px 18px;margin:0;border-radius:0}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05)}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem .yh-mega-icon{width:26px;font-size:18px}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem .yh-mega-title{font-size:16px}
.yh-mobile .yh-sec-single .yh-mega-sec{display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-sec-single .yh-mega-sec.yh-sec-on{display:block}
/* root vs sub */
.yh-mobile:not(.yh-sub) #yhPanels{display:none}
.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-promo,.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-menu{display:none}
/* omgekeerde inloghiërarchie */
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnLogin{order:1;border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnLogin:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08);color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnWebmail{order:2;border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-orange);color:#fff}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnWebmail:hover{border-color:#ff7440;background:#ff7440;color:#fff}
}

<script>
(function(){
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width:1023.98px)');

  function navIsActive(){
    var r = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!r) return false;
    return getComputedStyle(r).display !== 'none';
  }

  function reposition(){
    var root = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!root || !navIsActive()) return;
    var main = document.querySelector('main');
    if(main && main.parentNode && root.nextElementSibling !== main){
      main.parentNode.insertBefore(root, main);
    }
    var notif = document.querySelector('#site-header .notification-bar');
    if(notif && notif !== root.previousElementSibling){
      root.parentNode.insertBefore(notif, root);
    }
  }

  function init(){
    reposition();
    var ro = setInterval(function(){ if(navIsActive()){ reposition(); clearInterval(ro); } }, 300);
    setTimeout(function(){ clearInterval(ro); }, 6000);

    var nav      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-nav');
    var bar      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-bar');
    var menu     = document.getElementById('yhMenu');
    var actions  = document.getElementById('yhActions');
    var panels   = document.getElementById('yhPanels');
    var promo    = document.getElementById('yhPromo');
    var wide     = document.getElementById('mega-diensten');
    var cart     = document.getElementById('yhCart');
    var webmail  = document.getElementById('yhBtnWebmail');
    var login    = document.getElementById('yhBtnLogin');
    var scrim    = document.getElementById('yhScrim');
    var liDien   = document.getElementById('yhLiDiensten');
    var mobile   = document.getElementById('yhMobile');
    var overlay  = document.getElementById('yhOverlay');
    var mbody    = document.getElementById('yhMobileBody');
    var mfoot    = document.getElementById('yhFoot');
    var hamb     = document.getElementById('yhHamb');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('yhClose');
    var backBtn  = document.getElementById('yhBack');
    var backLbl  = document.getElementById('yhBackLabel');
    if(!nav || !menu || !panels || !mobile) return;

    /* ---------- desktop mega ---------- */
    var openTrig = null;

    function closeMega(){
      if(openTrig){
        var p = document.getElementById(openTrig.dataset.mega);
        if(p) p.classList.remove('open');
        openTrig.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        openTrig = null;
      }
      scrim.classList.remove('show');
    }

    function openMega(t){
      var panel = document.getElementById(t.dataset.mega);
      if(!panel) return;
      var isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
      closeMega();
      if(isOpen) return;
      if(panel.classList.contains('yh-mega--narrow')){
        var left = t.getBoundingClientRect().left - nav.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        var maxLeft = nav.clientWidth - panel.offsetWidth;
        if(left > maxLeft) left = Math.max(0, maxLeft);
        panel.style.left = left + 'px';
      }
      panel.classList.add('open');
      t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      scrim.classList.add('show');
      openTrig = t;
    }

    /* ---------- mobiele drawer ---------- */
    function mRoot(){
      mobile.classList.remove('yh-sub');
      var i, ps = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega');
      for(i=0;i<ps.length;i++) ps[i].classList.remove('yh-m-open','yh-sec-single');
      var ss = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
      for(i=0;i<ss.length;i++) ss[i].classList.remove('yh-sec-on');
      backBtn.hidden = true;
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function mOpen(id, sec){
      var p = document.getElementById(id);
      if(!p) return;
      mRoot();
      p.classList.add('yh-m-open');
      if(sec){
        var ss = p.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
        for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
          if(ss[i].dataset.sec === sec){ ss[i].classList.add('yh-sec-on'); p.classList.add('yh-sec-single'); }
        }
      }
      backLbl.textContent = sec || p.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Terug';
      backBtn.hidden = false;
      mobile.classList.add('yh-sub');
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function openMobile(){
      mRoot();
      mobile.classList.add('open');
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobile(){
      mobile.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    /* ---------- één DOM, twee shells ---------- */
    var gen = [], mode = null;

    function toMobile(){
      closeMega();
      mbody.appendChild(promo);
      mbody.appendChild(menu);
      mbody.appendChild(panels);
      mfoot.appendChild(login);
      mfoot.appendChild(webmail);

      var ss = [].slice.call(wide.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec'));
      ss.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.dataset.order|0) - (b.dataset.order|0); });
      for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var b  = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'yh-m-row';
        b.dataset.mega = 'mega-diensten';
        b.dataset.sec  = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        b.innerHTML = '<i class="yh-m-rowicon fa-regular ' + ss[i].dataset.icon + '"></i><span class="yh-m-rowlabel"></span><i class="fa-regular fa-chevron-right"></i>';
        b.querySelector('.yh-m-rowlabel').textContent = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        li.appendChild(b);
        menu.insertBefore(li, liDien);
        gen.push(li);
      }

      var cli = document.createElement('li');
      cli.appendChild(cart);
      menu.appendChild(cli);
      gen.push(cli);

      mRoot();
    }

    function toDesktop(){
      closeMobile();
      actions.appendChild(cart);
      for(var i=0;i<gen.length;i++){ if(gen[i].parentNode) gen[i].parentNode.removeChild(gen[i]); }
      gen = [];
      bar.insertBefore(menu, actions);
      actions.insertBefore(webmail, hamb);
      actions.insertBefore(login, hamb);
      wide.insertBefore(promo, wide.firstChild);
      nav.insertBefore(panels, scrim);
      mRoot();
    }

    function applyMode(){
      var m = MQ.matches ? 'm' : 'd';
      if(m === mode) return;
      mode = m;
      if(m === 'm') toMobile(); else toDesktop();
    }

    /* ---------- events ---------- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-mega]') : null;
      if(t){
        e.preventDefault();
        if(MQ.matches) mOpen(t.dataset.mega, t.dataset.sec);
        else openMega(t);
        return;
      }
      if(MQ.matches) return;
      if(e.target.closest('.yh-mega')) return;
      closeMega();
    });

    scrim.addEventListener('click', closeMega);
    hamb.addEventListener('click', openMobile);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    backBtn.addEventListener('click', mRoot);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      closeMega();
      if(mobile.classList.contains('open')) closeMobile();
    });

    if(MQ.addEventListener) MQ.addEventListener('change', applyMode);
    else if(MQ.addListener) MQ.addListener(applyMode);
    window.addEventListener('resize', applyMode);
    applyMode();
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  }else{
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

     Zoekt de countdown-afbeelding in de hero en legt de cijfers eroverheen.
     De afbeelding zelf voeg je in WordPress toe; deze snippet voegt geen afbeelding toe.
     Herkenning: alleen afbeeldingen met een bestandsnaam uit IMAGES hieronder
     (ook WordPress-varianten zoals -1024x1024 of .webp).
     Einddatum: END hieronder. Na afloop verdwijnen de cijfers vanzelf. -->

<style>
  .yh-cd-overlay { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; container-type: inline-size; z-index: 1; }
  .yh-cd-overlay .yh-cd__d {

<script nowprocket>
(function () {
  var END = Date.parse('2026-12-01T00:00:00+01:00'); // = t/m 30 november, Nederlandse tijd

  // Per afbeelding: bestandsnaam (zonder extensie), posities van de vier tegels
  // in % van de afbeelding [links, boven], cijfergrootte (% van de breedte) en kanteling
  var IMAGES = [
    { file: 'Landingspagina-Joeri-countdown',
      pos: [[25.2, 56.6], [33.5, 54.8], [45.2, 52.2], [53.5, 50.5]],
      size: 5.8, angle: -12 },
    { file: 'joeri-staand-countdown',
      pos: [[39.0, 64.0], [47.5, 62.1], [59.4, 59.6], [67.7, 57.7]],
      size: 6.4, angle: -12 }
  ];

  // Exact deze bestandsnaam, eventueel met -1024x1024 en/of een andere extensie (.png, .webp, .png.webp)
  IMAGES.forEach(function (cfg) {
    cfg.re = new RegExp('/' + cfg.file + '(-\\d+x\\d+)?(\\.[a-z0-9]+)+(\\?|\\s|,|$)', 'i');
  });

  function findConfig(img) {
    var srcs = [img.currentSrc, img.src, img.srcset,
                img.getAttribute('data-lazy-src'), img.getAttribute('data-src')];
    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    if (pic) pic.querySelectorAll('source').forEach(function (s) {
      srcs.push(s.srcset, s.getAttribute('data-lazy-srcset'));
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < IMAGES.length; i++) {
      var re = IMAGES[i].re;
      if (srcs.some(function (u) { return u && re.test(u); })) return IMAGES[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function attach(img, cfg) {
    if (img.dataset.yhCd) return;
    img.dataset.yhCd = '1';

    // Bij <picture> komt de cijferlaag naast het picture-element, niet erin
    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    var parent = (pic || img).parentElement;
    if (getComputedStyle(parent).position === 'static') parent.style.position = 'relative';

    var box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'yh-cd-overlay';
    box.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-size', cfg.size + 'cqw');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-angle', cfg.angle + 'deg');
    var digits = cfg.pos.map(function (p) {
      var s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'yh-cd__d';
      s.style.left = p[0] + '%';
      s.style.top = p[1] + '%';
      box.appendChild(s);
      return s;
    });
    parent.appendChild(box);

    // Overlay exact over de afbeelding leggen, ook als de layout verandert
    function place() {
      var r = img.getBoundingClientRect(), pr = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
      box.style.left = (r.left - pr.left - parent.clientLeft) + 'px';
      box.style.top = (r.top - pr.top - parent.clientTop) + 'px';
      box.style.width = r.width + 'px';
      box.style.height = r.height + 'px';
    }
    place();
    img.addEventListener('load', place);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(place).observe(img);
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);

    function update() {
      var ms = END - Date.now();
      if (ms <= 0) { box.remove(); return; }
      var days = Math.min(99, Math.floor(ms / 864e5));
      var hours = Math.floor((ms % 864e5) / 36e5);
      var s = String(days).padStart(2, '0') + String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
      digits.forEach(function (el, i) { el.textContent = s[i]; });
      setTimeout(update, 60000 - (Date.now() % 60000));
    }
    update();
  }

  function init() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.images, function (img) {
      var cfg = findConfig(img);
      if (cfg) attach(img, cfg);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();

<style>#yh-nav-root{display:none}</style>

<div  id="yh-nav-root">
<style>
:root{--yh-black:#181818;--yh-beige:#F5F3EE;--yh-orange:#FF8657;--yh-grey:#666;--yh-white:#fff;--yh-gradient:linear-gradient(to right,#bc509b 0,#bc509b 20%,#e84985 20%,#e84985 40%,#ff665e 40%,#ff665e 60%,#ff8657 60%,#ff8657 80%,#ffb357 80%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-grad-s:linear-gradient(135deg,#bc509b 0,#e84985 30%,#ff665e 56%,#ff8657 78%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-radius:20px;--yh-nav-h:72px}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.yh-nav,.yh-nav *,.yh-mobile,.yh-mobile *{font-family:"Gilroy",sans-serif}
#yh-nav-root .yh-mega-item *,#yh-nav-root .yh-m-row *,#yh-nav-root .yh-link *,#yh-nav-root .yh-btn i,#yh-nav-root .yh-cart *{pointer-events:none}

/* bar */
.yh-nav{position:relative;z-index:1000;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--yh-beige);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-nav::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--yh-gradient)}
.yh-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;max-width:1440px;min-width:0;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;height:var(--yh-nav-h)}
.yh-logo{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;width:150px;height:34px;overflow:hidden;text-indent:-9999px;background:url("https://www.yourhosting.nl/wp-content/uploads/yh-logo.svg") no-repeat center/contain}
.yh-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex:1;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-menu>li{position:static}
.yh-menu>li.has-narrow{position:relative}
.yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:none}
.yh-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.yh-link:hover,.yh-link:hover .fa-chevron-down,.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true]{color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-link .fa-chevron-down{font-size:12px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .2s,color .15s}
.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--yh-orange)}

/* actions */
.yh-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto}
.yh-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:all .15s}
.yh-btn--ghost{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-btn--solid{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-orange);color:#fff}
.yh-btn--solid:hover{border-color:#ff7440;background:#ff7440;color:#fff}
.yh-cart{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.yh-cart:hover i{filter:brightness(.9)}
.yh-hamb{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-hamb i{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1}

/* mega */
.yh-mega{position:absolute;top:100%;z-index:1001;padding:32px;border-radius:var(--yh-radius);background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(24,24,24,.13);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-mega.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--wide{left:50%;width:calc(100vw - 48px);max-width:1024px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}
.yh-mega--wide.open{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--narrow{left:0;width:660px}
#mega-services .yh-mega-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,auto);grid-auto-flow:column;gap:16px 32px}
.yh-mega-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px 40px}
.yh-mega-col-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.yh-mega-heading{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:500!important;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-mega-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-mega-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;padding:4px;margin:-4px;border-radius:12px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:background .15s}
.yh-mega-item:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-mega-icon,.yh-m-rowicon,.yh-cart i{background:var(--yh-gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
.yh-mega-icon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;margin-top:2px;font-size:17px;text-align:center}
.yh-mega-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.yh-mega-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mega-sub{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--yh-grey)}

/* gepromoveerde rij */
.yh-promo{margin:0 0 26px}
.yh-promo-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-promo-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0;border:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.07);border-radius:16px;background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(24,24,24,.04);transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover{border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,134,87,.2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;margin:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:19px;background:var(--yh-grad-s);-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff;color:#fff}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-txt{flex:1;min-width:0}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-title{font-size:16px}
.yh-promo-arrow{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .15s,color .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover .yh-promo-arrow{color:var(--yh-orange);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* drawer */
.yh-overlay,.yh-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(24,24,24,.5);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s,visibility .25s}
.yh-overlay{z-index:1999}
.yh-scrim{z-index:999;transition:opacity .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-overlay.open,.yh-scrim.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.yh-mobile{position:fixed;top:7vh;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:400px;max-width:100vw;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:-12px 0 40px rgba(24,24,24,.18);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.yh-mobile.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.yh-mobile-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:42px;padding:3px 10px 3px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-m-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-m-title{display:none}
.yh-mobile-spacer{flex:1}
.yh-mobile-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-back i{font-size:15px}
.yh-mobile-back[hidden]{display:none}
.yh-mobile-close{padding:8px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.yh-mobile-foot{display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-mobile-foot .yh-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:12px 10px;font-size:15px}
.yh-m-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.yh-m-row:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05)}
.yh-m-rowicon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-m-row .yh-m-rowlabel{flex:1}
.yh-m-row .fa-chevron-right{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--yh-grey);color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-width:1200px){
.yh-bar{gap:18px;padding:0 16px}.yh-menu{gap:12px}.yh-link{font-size:15px}.yh-btn{gap:7px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px}.yh-logo{width:128px}.yh-promo-list{gap:12px}.yh-promo-item{padding:14px}.yh-mega--narrow{width:620px}
}
@media (min-width:1024px){.yh-mobile,.yh-overlay{display:none}}
@media (max-width:1023.98px){
.yh-bar{justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.yh-bar .yh-menu,.yh-actions .yh-btn,.yh-bar .yh-cart{display:none}
.yh-actions{order:2;gap:10px}
.yh-hamb{display:inline-flex;order:2}
/* hoofdmenu = root-lijst van de drawer */
.yh-mobile .yh-menu{display:block;flex:none;padding:2px 0}
.yh-mobile #yhLiDiensten{display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-link,.yh-mobile .yh-cart{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile .yh-link:hover,.yh-mobile .yh-cart:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile .yh-link .yh-m-rowicon,.yh-mobile .yh-cart i{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-link .fa-chevron-down,.yh-mobile .yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.yh-mobile .yh-cart .yh-sr-only{position:static;width:auto;height:auto;margin:0;overflow:visible;clip:auto;white-space:normal}
/* promo als 3 tiles bovenaan */
.yh-mobile .yh-promo{margin:0;padding:2px 0 8px}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo .yh-mega-heading{margin:0;padding:4px 18px;font-size:12px!important}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;padding:0 14px}

<script>
(function(){
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width:1023.98px)');

  function navIsActive(){
    var r = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!r) return false;
    return getComputedStyle(r).display !== 'none';
  }

  function reposition(){
    var root = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!root || !navIsActive()) return;
    var main = document.querySelector('main');
    if(main && main.parentNode && root.nextElementSibling !== main){
      main.parentNode.insertBefore(root, main);
    }
    var notif = document.querySelector('#site-header .notification-bar');
    if(notif && notif !== root.previousElementSibling){
      root.parentNode.insertBefore(notif, root);
    }
  }

  function init(){
    reposition();
    var ro = setInterval(function(){ if(navIsActive()){ reposition(); clearInterval(ro); } }, 300);
    setTimeout(function(){ clearInterval(ro); }, 6000);

    var nav      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-nav');
    var bar      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-bar');
    var menu     = document.getElementById('yhMenu');
    var actions  = document.getElementById('yhActions');
    var panels   = document.getElementById('yhPanels');
    var promo    = document.getElementById('yhPromo');
    var wide     = document.getElementById('mega-diensten');
    var cart     = document.getElementById('yhCart');
    var webmail  = document.getElementById('yhBtnWebmail');
    var login    = document.getElementById('yhBtnLogin');
    var scrim    = document.getElementById('yhScrim');
    var liDien   = document.getElementById('yhLiDiensten');
    var mobile   = document.getElementById('yhMobile');
    var overlay  = document.getElementById('yhOverlay');
    var mbody    = document.getElementById('yhMobileBody');
    var mfoot    = document.getElementById('yhFoot');
    var hamb     = document.getElementById('yhHamb');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('yhClose');
    var backBtn  = document.getElementById('yhBack');
    var backLbl  = document.getElementById('yhBackLabel');
    if(!nav || !menu || !panels || !mobile) return;

    /* ---------- desktop mega ---------- */
    var openTrig = null;

    function closeMega(){
      if(openTrig){
        var p = document.getElementById(openTrig.dataset.mega);
        if(p) p.classList.remove('open');
        openTrig.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        openTrig = null;
      }
      scrim.classList.remove('show');
    }

    function openMega(t){
      var panel = document.getElementById(t.dataset.mega);
      if(!panel) return;
      var isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
      closeMega();
      if(isOpen) return;
      if(panel.classList.contains('yh-mega--narrow')){
        var left = t.getBoundingClientRect().left - nav.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        var maxLeft = nav.clientWidth - panel.offsetWidth;
        if(left > maxLeft) left = Math.max(0, maxLeft);
        panel.style.left = left + 'px';
      }
      panel.classList.add('open');
      t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      scrim.classList.add('show');
      openTrig = t;
    }

    /* ---------- mobiele drawer ---------- */
    function mRoot(){
      mobile.classList.remove('yh-sub');
      var i, ps = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega');
      for(i=0;i<ps.length;i++) ps[i].classList.remove('yh-m-open','yh-sec-single');
      var ss = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
      for(i=0;i<ss.length;i++) ss[i].classList.remove('yh-sec-on');
      backBtn.hidden = true;
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function mOpen(id, sec){
      var p = document.getElementById(id);
      if(!p) return;
      mRoot();
      p.classList.add('yh-m-open');
      if(sec){
        var ss = p.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
        for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
          if(ss[i].dataset.sec === sec){ ss[i].classList.add('yh-sec-on'); p.classList.add('yh-sec-single'); }
        }
      }
      backLbl.textContent = sec || p.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Terug';
      backBtn.hidden = false;
      mobile.classList.add('yh-sub');
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function openMobile(){
      mRoot();
      mobile.classList.add('open');
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobile(){
      mobile.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    /* ---------- één DOM, twee shells ---------- */
    var gen = [], mode = null;

    function toMobile(){
      closeMega();
      mbody.appendChild(promo);
      mbody.appendChild(menu);
      mbody.appendChild(panels);
      mfoot.appendChild(login);
      mfoot.appendChild(webmail);

      var ss = [].slice.call(wide.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec'));
      ss.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.dataset.order|0) - (b.dataset.order|0); });
      for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var b  = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'yh-m-row';
        b.dataset.mega = 'mega-diensten';
        b.dataset.sec  = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        b.innerHTML = '<i class="yh-m-rowicon fa-regular ' + ss[i].dataset.icon + '"></i><span class="yh-m-rowlabel"></span><i class="fa-regular fa-chevron-right"></i>';
        b.querySelector('.yh-m-rowlabel').textContent = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        li.appendChild(b);
        menu.insertBefore(li, liDien);
        gen.push(li);
      }

      var cli = document.createElement('li');
      cli.appendChild(cart);
      menu.appendChild(cli);
      gen.push(cli);

      mRoot();
    }

    function toDesktop(){
      closeMobile();
      actions.appendChild(cart);
      for(var i=0;i<gen.length;i++){ if(gen[i].parentNode) gen[i].parentNode.removeChild(gen[i]); }
      gen = [];
      bar.insertBefore(menu, actions);
      actions.insertBefore(webmail, hamb);
      actions.insertBefore(login, hamb);
      wide.insertBefore(promo, wide.firstChild);
      nav.insertBefore(panels, scrim);
      mRoot();
    }

    function applyMode(){
      var m = MQ.matches ? 'm' : 'd';
      if(m === mode) return;
      mode = m;
      if(m === 'm') toMobile(); else toDesktop();
    }

    /* ---------- events ---------- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-mega]') : null;
      if(t){
        e.preventDefault();
        if(MQ.matches) mOpen(t.dataset.mega, t.dataset.sec);
        else openMega(t);
        return;
      }
      if(MQ.matches) return;
      if(e.target.closest('.yh-mega')) return;
      closeMega();
    });

    scrim.addEventListener('click', closeMega);
    hamb.addEventListener('click', openMobile);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    backBtn.addEventListener('click', mRoot);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      closeMega();
      if(mobile.classList.contains('open')) closeMobile();
    });

    if(MQ.addEventListener) MQ.addEventListener('change', applyMode);

			<!-- Yourhosting countdown (website-versie)
     Zoekt de countdown-afbeelding in de hero en legt de cijfers eroverheen.
     De afbeelding zelf voeg je in WordPress toe; deze snippet voegt geen afbeelding toe.
     Herkenning: alleen afbeeldingen met een bestandsnaam uit IMAGES hieronder
     (ook WordPress-varianten zoals -1024x1024 of .webp).
     Einddatum: END hieronder. Na afloop verdwijnen de cijfers vanzelf. -->

<style>
  .yh-cd-overlay { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; container-type: inline-size; z-index: 1; }
  .yh-cd-overlay .yh-cd__d {
    position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--yh-cd-angle, -12deg));
    /* !important: het thema overschrijft anders het fontgewicht */
    font-family: 'Gilroy', Arial, sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
    font-style: normal !important;
    font-size: var(--yh-cd-size, 5.8cqw) !important;
    line-height: 1 !important;
    font-synthesis: weight !important;
    color: #BC509B !important;
  }
</style>

<script nowprocket>
(function () {
  var END = Date.parse('2026-12-01T00:00:00+01:00'); // = t/m 30 november, Nederlandse tijd

  // Per afbeelding: bestandsnaam (zonder extensie), posities van de vier tegels
  // in % van de afbeelding [links, boven], cijfergrootte (% van de breedte) en kanteling
  var IMAGES = [
    { file: 'Landingspagina-Joeri-countdown',
      pos: [[25.2, 56.6], [33.5, 54.8], [45.2, 52.2], [53.5, 50.5]],
      size: 5.8, angle: -12 },
    { file: 'joeri-staand-countdown',
      pos: [[39.0, 64.0], [47.5, 62.1], [59.4, 59.6], [67.7, 57.7]],
      size: 6.4, angle: -12 }
  ];

  // Exact deze bestandsnaam, eventueel met -1024x1024 en/of een andere extensie (.png, .webp, .png.webp)
  IMAGES.forEach(function (cfg) {
    cfg.re = new RegExp('/' + cfg.file + '(-\\d+x\\d+)?(\\.[a-z0-9]+)+(\\?|\\s|,|$)', 'i');
  });

  function findConfig(img) {
    var srcs = [img.currentSrc, img.src, img.srcset,
                img.getAttribute('data-lazy-src'), img.getAttribute('data-src')];
    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    if (pic) pic.querySelectorAll('source').forEach(function (s) {
      srcs.push(s.srcset, s.getAttribute('data-lazy-srcset'));
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < IMAGES.length; i++) {
      var re = IMAGES[i].re;
      if (srcs.some(function (u) { return u && re.test(u); })) return IMAGES[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function attach(img, cfg) {
    if (img.dataset.yhCd) return;
    img.dataset.yhCd = '1';

    // Bij <picture> komt de cijferlaag naast het picture-element, niet erin
    var pic = img.closest('picture');
    var parent = (pic || img).parentElement;
    if (getComputedStyle(parent).position === 'static') parent.style.position = 'relative';

    var box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'yh-cd-overlay';
    box.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-size', cfg.size + 'cqw');
    box.style.setProperty('--yh-cd-angle', cfg.angle + 'deg');
    var digits = cfg.pos.map(function (p) {
      var s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'yh-cd__d';
      s.style.left = p[0] + '%';
      s.style.top = p[1] + '%';
      box.appendChild(s);
      return s;
    });
    parent.appendChild(box);

    // Overlay exact over de afbeelding leggen, ook als de layout verandert
    function place() {
      var r = img.getBoundingClientRect(), pr = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
      box.style.left = (r.left - pr.left - parent.clientLeft) + 'px';
      box.style.top = (r.top - pr.top - parent.clientTop) + 'px';
      box.style.width = r.width + 'px';
      box.style.height = r.height + 'px';
    }
    place();
    img.addEventListener('load', place);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(place).observe(img);
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);

    function update() {
      var ms = END - Date.now();
      if (ms <= 0) { box.remove(); return; }
      var days = Math.min(99, Math.floor(ms / 864e5));
      var hours = Math.floor((ms % 864e5) / 36e5);
      var s = String(days).padStart(2, '0') + String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
      digits.forEach(function (el, i) { el.textContent = s[i]; });
      setTimeout(update, 60000 - (Date.now() % 60000));
    }
    update();
  }

  function init() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.images, function (img) {
      var cfg = findConfig(img);
      if (cfg) attach(img, cfg);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

:root{--yh-black:#181818;--yh-beige:#F5F3EE;--yh-orange:#FF8657;--yh-grey:#666;--yh-white:#fff;--yh-gradient:linear-gradient(to right,#bc509b 0,#bc509b 20%,#e84985 20%,#e84985 40%,#ff665e 40%,#ff665e 60%,#ff8657 60%,#ff8657 80%,#ffb357 80%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-grad-s:linear-gradient(135deg,#bc509b 0,#e84985 30%,#ff665e 56%,#ff8657 78%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-radius:20px;--yh-nav-h:72px}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.yh-nav,.yh-nav *,.yh-mobile,.yh-mobile *{font-family:"Gilroy",sans-serif}
#yh-nav-root .yh-mega-item *,#yh-nav-root .yh-m-row *,#yh-nav-root .yh-link *,#yh-nav-root .yh-btn i,#yh-nav-root .yh-cart *{pointer-events:none}

/* bar */
.yh-nav{position:relative;z-index:1000;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--yh-beige);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-nav::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--yh-gradient)}
.yh-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;max-width:1440px;min-width:0;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;height:var(--yh-nav-h)}
.yh-logo{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;width:150px;height:34px;overflow:hidden;text-indent:-9999px;background:url("https://www.yourhosting.nl/wp-content/uploads/yh-logo.svg") no-repeat center/contain}
.yh-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex:1;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-menu>li{position:static}
.yh-menu>li.has-narrow{position:relative}
.yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:none}
.yh-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.yh-link:hover,.yh-link:hover .fa-chevron-down,.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true]{color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-link .fa-chevron-down{font-size:12px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .2s,color .15s}
.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--yh-orange)}

/* actions */
.yh-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto}
.yh-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:all .15s}
.yh-btn--ghost{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-btn--solid{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-orange);color:#fff}
.yh-btn--solid:hover{border-color:#ff7440;background:#ff7440;color:#fff}
.yh-cart{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.yh-cart:hover i{filter:brightness(.9)}
.yh-hamb{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px;border:0;background:none;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-hamb i{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1}

/* mega */
.yh-mega{position:absolute;top:100%;z-index:1001;padding:32px;border-radius:var(--yh-radius);background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(24,24,24,.13);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-mega.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--wide{left:50%;width:calc(100vw - 48px);max-width:1024px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}
.yh-mega--wide.open{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.yh-mega--narrow{left:0;width:660px}
#mega-services .yh-mega-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(4,auto);grid-auto-flow:column;gap:16px 32px}
.yh-mega-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px 40px}
.yh-mega-col-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.yh-mega-heading{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:500!important;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-mega-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-mega-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;padding:4px;margin:-4px;border-radius:12px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:background .15s}
.yh-mega-item:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}
.yh-mega-icon,.yh-m-rowicon,.yh-cart i{background:var(--yh-gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
.yh-mega-icon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;margin-top:2px;font-size:17px;text-align:center}
.yh-mega-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.yh-mega-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mega-sub{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--yh-grey)}

/* gepromoveerde rij */
.yh-promo{margin:0 0 26px}
.yh-promo-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-promo-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0;border:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.07);border-radius:16px;background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(24,24,24,.04);transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover{border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-white);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,134,87,.2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;margin:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:19px;background:var(--yh-grad-s);-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff;color:#fff}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-txt{flex:1;min-width:0}
.yh-promo-item .yh-mega-title{font-size:16px}
.yh-promo-arrow{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .15s,color .15s}
.yh-promo-item:hover .yh-promo-arrow{color:var(--yh-orange);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* drawer */
.yh-overlay,.yh-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(24,24,24,.5);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s,visibility .25s}
.yh-overlay{z-index:1999}
.yh-scrim{z-index:999;transition:opacity .18s,visibility .18s}
.yh-overlay.open,.yh-scrim.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.yh-mobile{position:fixed;top:7vh;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:400px;max-width:100vw;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:var(--yh-beige);box-shadow:-12px 0 40px rgba(24,24,24,.18);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.yh-mobile.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.yh-mobile-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:42px;padding:3px 10px 3px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-m-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-m-title{display:none}
.yh-mobile-spacer{flex:1}
.yh-mobile-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-back i{font-size:15px}
.yh-mobile-back[hidden]{display:none}
.yh-mobile-close{padding:8px;border:0;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);cursor:pointer}
.yh-mobile-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.yh-mobile-foot{display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid rgba(24,24,24,.08)}
.yh-mobile-foot .yh-btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:12px 10px;font-size:15px}
.yh-m-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border:0;background:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--yh-black);text-align:left;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.yh-m-row:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05)}
.yh-m-rowicon{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-m-row .yh-m-rowlabel{flex:1}
.yh-m-row .fa-chevron-right{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--yh-grey);color:var(--yh-grey)}
.yh-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-width:1200px){

.yh-mobile .yh-link .yh-m-rowicon,.yh-mobile .yh-cart i{flex:0 0 auto;width:24px;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-link .fa-chevron-down,.yh-mobile .yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--yh-grey);transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.yh-mobile .yh-cart .yh-sr-only{position:static;width:auto;height:auto;margin:0;overflow:visible;clip:auto;white-space:normal}
/* promo als 3 tiles bovenaan */

.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-icon{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:16px}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-txt{flex:none;align-items:center}
.yh-mobile .yh-promo-item .yh-mega-title{font-size:13px}
/* mega-panels = subpanels */
.yh-mobile .yh-mega{position:static;left:auto!important;width:auto;max-width:none;padding:6px 0;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega.yh-m-open{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega-grid,.yh-mobile .yh-mega-col-group,.yh-mobile #mega-services .yh-mega-list{display:block}
.yh-mobile .yh-mega-list{gap:0}
#yhPanels .yh-mega-heading{display:none}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem{gap:14px;padding:13px 18px;margin:0;border-radius:0}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem:hover{background:rgba(24,24,24,.05)}
#yhPanels .yh-m-ditem .yh-mega-icon{width:26px;font-size:18px}

.yh-mobile .yh-sec-single .yh-mega-sec{display:none}
.yh-mobile .yh-sec-single .yh-mega-sec.yh-sec-on{display:block}
/* root vs sub */
.yh-mobile:not(.yh-sub) #yhPanels{display:none}
.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-promo,.yh-mobile.yh-sub .yh-menu{display:none}
/* omgekeerde inloghiërarchie */
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnLogin{order:1;border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnLogin:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08);color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnWebmail{order:2;border-color:var(--yh-orange);background:var(--yh-orange);color:#fff}
.yh-mobile-foot #yhBtnWebmail:hover{border-color:#ff7440;background:#ff7440;color:#fff}
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width:1023.98px)');

  function navIsActive(){
    var r = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!r) return false;
    return getComputedStyle(r).display !== 'none';
  }

  function reposition(){
    var root = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!root || !navIsActive()) return;
    var main = document.querySelector('main');
    if(main && main.parentNode && root.nextElementSibling !== main){
      main.parentNode.insertBefore(root, main);
    }
    var notif = document.querySelector('#site-header .notification-bar');
    if(notif && notif !== root.previousElementSibling){
      root.parentNode.insertBefore(notif, root);
    }
  }

  function init(){
    reposition();
    var ro = setInterval(function(){ if(navIsActive()){ reposition(); clearInterval(ro); } }, 300);
    setTimeout(function(){ clearInterval(ro); }, 6000);

    var nav      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-nav');
    var bar      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-bar');
    var menu     = document.getElementById('yhMenu');
    var actions  = document.getElementById('yhActions');
    var panels   = document.getElementById('yhPanels');
    var promo    = document.getElementById('yhPromo');
    var wide     = document.getElementById('mega-diensten');
    var cart     = document.getElementById('yhCart');
    var webmail  = document.getElementById('yhBtnWebmail');
    var login    = document.getElementById('yhBtnLogin');
    var scrim    = document.getElementById('yhScrim');
    var liDien   = document.getElementById('yhLiDiensten');
    var mobile   = document.getElementById('yhMobile');
    var overlay  = document.getElementById('yhOverlay');
    var mbody    = document.getElementById('yhMobileBody');
    var mfoot    = document.getElementById('yhFoot');
    var hamb     = document.getElementById('yhHamb');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('yhClose');
    var backBtn  = document.getElementById('yhBack');
    var backLbl  = document.getElementById('yhBackLabel');
    if(!nav || !menu || !panels || !mobile) return;

    /* ---------- desktop mega ---------- */
    var openTrig = null;

    function closeMega(){
      if(openTrig){
        var p = document.getElementById(openTrig.dataset.mega);
        if(p) p.classList.remove('open');
        openTrig.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        openTrig = null;
      }
      scrim.classList.remove('show');
    }

    function openMega(t){
      var panel = document.getElementById(t.dataset.mega);
      if(!panel) return;
      var isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
      closeMega();
      if(isOpen) return;
      if(panel.classList.contains('yh-mega--narrow')){
        var left = t.getBoundingClientRect().left - nav.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        var maxLeft = nav.clientWidth - panel.offsetWidth;
        if(left > maxLeft) left = Math.max(0, maxLeft);
        panel.style.left = left + 'px';
      }
      panel.classList.add('open');
      t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      scrim.classList.add('show');
      openTrig = t;
    }

    /* ---------- mobiele drawer ---------- */
    function mRoot(){
      mobile.classList.remove('yh-sub');
      var i, ps = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega');
      for(i=0;i<ps.length;i++) ps[i].classList.remove('yh-m-open','yh-sec-single');
      var ss = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
      for(i=0;i<ss.length;i++) ss[i].classList.remove('yh-sec-on');
      backBtn.hidden = true;
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function mOpen(id, sec){
      var p = document.getElementById(id);
      if(!p) return;
      mRoot();
      p.classList.add('yh-m-open');
      if(sec){
        var ss = p.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
        for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
          if(ss[i].dataset.sec === sec){ ss[i].classList.add('yh-sec-on'); p.classList.add('yh-sec-single'); }
        }
      }
      backLbl.textContent = sec || p.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Terug';
      backBtn.hidden = false;
      mobile.classList.add('yh-sub');
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function openMobile(){
      mRoot();
      mobile.classList.add('open');
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobile(){
      mobile.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    /* ---------- één DOM, twee shells ---------- */
    var gen = [], mode = null;

    function toMobile(){
      closeMega();
      mbody.appendChild(promo);
      mbody.appendChild(menu);
      mbody.appendChild(panels);
      mfoot.appendChild(login);
      mfoot.appendChild(webmail);

      var ss = [].slice.call(wide.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec'));
      ss.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.dataset.order|0) - (b.dataset.order|0); });
      for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var b  = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'yh-m-row';
        b.dataset.mega = 'mega-diensten';
        b.dataset.sec  = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        b.innerHTML = '<i class="yh-m-rowicon fa-regular ' + ss[i].dataset.icon + '"></i><span class="yh-m-rowlabel"></span><i class="fa-regular fa-chevron-right"></i>';
        b.querySelector('.yh-m-rowlabel').textContent = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        li.appendChild(b);
        menu.insertBefore(li, liDien);
        gen.push(li);
      }

      var cli = document.createElement('li');
      cli.appendChild(cart);
      menu.appendChild(cli);
      gen.push(cli);

      mRoot();
    }

    function toDesktop(){
      closeMobile();
      actions.appendChild(cart);
      for(var i=0;i<gen.length;i++){ if(gen[i].parentNode) gen[i].parentNode.removeChild(gen[i]); }
      gen = [];
      bar.insertBefore(menu, actions);
      actions.insertBefore(webmail, hamb);
      actions.insertBefore(login, hamb);
      wide.insertBefore(promo, wide.firstChild);
      nav.insertBefore(panels, scrim);
      mRoot();
    }

    function applyMode(){
      var m = MQ.matches ? 'm' : 'd';
      if(m === mode) return;
      mode = m;
      if(m === 'm') toMobile(); else toDesktop();
    }

    /* ---------- events ---------- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-mega]') : null;
      if(t){
        e.preventDefault();
        if(MQ.matches) mOpen(t.dataset.mega, t.dataset.sec);
        else openMega(t);
        return;
      }
      if(MQ.matches) return;
      if(e.target.closest('.yh-mega')) return;
      closeMega();
    });

    scrim.addEventListener('click', closeMega);
    hamb.addEventListener('click', openMobile);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    backBtn.addEventListener('click', mRoot);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      closeMega();
      if(mobile.classList.contains('open')) closeMobile();
    });

    if(MQ.addEventListener) MQ.addEventListener('change', applyMode);
    else if(MQ.addListener) MQ.addListener(applyMode);
    window.addEventListener('resize', applyMode);
    applyMode();
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  }else{
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<div id="yh-nav-root">
<style>
:root{--yh-black:#181818;--yh-beige:#F5F3EE;--yh-orange:#FF8657;--yh-grey:#666;--yh-white:#fff;--yh-gradient:linear-gradient(to right,#bc509b 0,#bc509b 20%,#e84985 20%,#e84985 40%,#ff665e 40%,#ff665e 60%,#ff8657 60%,#ff8657 80%,#ffb357 80%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-grad-s:linear-gradient(135deg,#bc509b 0,#e84985 30%,#ff665e 56%,#ff8657 78%,#ffb357 100%);--yh-radius:20px;--yh-nav-h:72px}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.yh-nav,.yh-nav *,.yh-mobile,.yh-mobile *{font-family:"Gilroy",sans-serif}
#yh-nav-root .yh-mega-item *,#yh-nav-root .yh-m-row *,#yh-nav-root .yh-link *,#yh-nav-root .yh-btn i,#yh-nav-root .yh-cart *{pointer-events:none}

/* bar */
.yh-nav{position:relative;z-index:1000;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--yh-beige);color:var(--yh-black)}
.yh-nav::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--yh-gradient)}
.yh-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;max-width:1440px;min-width:0;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;height:var(--yh-nav-h)}
.yh-logo{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;width:150px;height:34px;overflow:hidden;text-indent:-9999px;background:url("https://www.yourhosting.nl/wp-content/uploads/yh-logo.svg") no-repeat center/contain}
.yh-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex:1;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.yh-menu>li{position:static}
.yh-menu>li.has-narrow{position:relative}
.yh-menu .yh-m-rowicon{display:none}
.yh-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--yh-black);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.yh-link:hover,.yh-link:hover .fa-chevron-down,.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true]{color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-link .fa-chevron-down{font-size:12px;color:var(--yh-grey);transition:transform .2s,color .15s}
.yh-trigger[aria-expanded=true] .fa-chevron-down{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--yh-orange)}

/* actions */
.yh-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto}
.yh-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:all .15s}
.yh-btn--ghost{border:1.5px solid var(--yh-orange);background:transparent;color:var(--yh-orange)}
.yh-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,134,87,.08)}

    <span class="yh-mobile-spacer"></span>

<script>
(function(){
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width:1023.98px)');

  function navIsActive(){
    var r = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!r) return false;
    return getComputedStyle(r).display !== 'none';
  }

  function reposition(){
    var root = document.getElementById('yh-nav-root');
    if(!root || !navIsActive()) return;
    var main = document.querySelector('main');
    if(main && main.parentNode && root.nextElementSibling !== main){
      main.parentNode.insertBefore(root, main);
    }
    var notif = document.querySelector('#site-header .notification-bar');
    if(notif && notif !== root.previousElementSibling){
      root.parentNode.insertBefore(notif, root);
    }
  }

  function init(){
    reposition();
    var ro = setInterval(function(){ if(navIsActive()){ reposition(); clearInterval(ro); } }, 300);
    setTimeout(function(){ clearInterval(ro); }, 6000);

    var nav      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-nav');
    var bar      = document.querySelector('#yh-nav-root .yh-bar');
    var menu     = document.getElementById('yhMenu');
    var actions  = document.getElementById('yhActions');
    var panels   = document.getElementById('yhPanels');
    var promo    = document.getElementById('yhPromo');
    var wide     = document.getElementById('mega-diensten');
    var cart     = document.getElementById('yhCart');
    var webmail  = document.getElementById('yhBtnWebmail');
    var login    = document.getElementById('yhBtnLogin');
    var scrim    = document.getElementById('yhScrim');
    var liDien   = document.getElementById('yhLiDiensten');
    var mobile   = document.getElementById('yhMobile');
    var overlay  = document.getElementById('yhOverlay');
    var mbody    = document.getElementById('yhMobileBody');
    var mfoot    = document.getElementById('yhFoot');
    var hamb     = document.getElementById('yhHamb');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('yhClose');
    var backBtn  = document.getElementById('yhBack');
    var backLbl  = document.getElementById('yhBackLabel');
    if(!nav || !menu || !panels || !mobile) return;

    /* ---------- desktop mega ---------- */
    var openTrig = null;

    function closeMega(){
      if(openTrig){
        var p = document.getElementById(openTrig.dataset.mega);
        if(p) p.classList.remove('open');
        openTrig.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        openTrig = null;
      }
      scrim.classList.remove('show');
    }

    function openMega(t){
      var panel = document.getElementById(t.dataset.mega);
      if(!panel) return;
      var isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
      closeMega();
      if(isOpen) return;
      if(panel.classList.contains('yh-mega--narrow')){
        var left = t.getBoundingClientRect().left - nav.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        var maxLeft = nav.clientWidth - panel.offsetWidth;
        if(left > maxLeft) left = Math.max(0, maxLeft);
        panel.style.left = left + 'px';
      }
      panel.classList.add('open');
      t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      scrim.classList.add('show');
      openTrig = t;
    }

    /* ---------- mobiele drawer ---------- */
    function mRoot(){
      mobile.classList.remove('yh-sub');
      var i, ps = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega');
      for(i=0;i<ps.length;i++) ps[i].classList.remove('yh-m-open','yh-sec-single');
      var ss = panels.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
      for(i=0;i<ss.length;i++) ss[i].classList.remove('yh-sec-on');
      backBtn.hidden = true;
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function mOpen(id, sec){
      var p = document.getElementById(id);
      if(!p) return;
      mRoot();
      p.classList.add('yh-m-open');
      if(sec){
        var ss = p.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec');
        for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
          if(ss[i].dataset.sec === sec){ ss[i].classList.add('yh-sec-on'); p.classList.add('yh-sec-single'); }
        }
      }
      backLbl.textContent = sec || p.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Terug';
      backBtn.hidden = false;
      mobile.classList.add('yh-sub');
      mbody.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    function openMobile(){
      mRoot();
      mobile.classList.add('open');
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobile(){
      mobile.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      mobile.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      hamb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    /* ---------- één DOM, twee shells ---------- */
    var gen = [], mode = null;

    function toMobile(){
      closeMega();
      mbody.appendChild(promo);
      mbody.appendChild(menu);
      mbody.appendChild(panels);
      mfoot.appendChild(login);
      mfoot.appendChild(webmail);

      var ss = [].slice.call(wide.querySelectorAll('.yh-mega-sec'));
      ss.sort(function(a,b){ return (a.dataset.order|0) - (b.dataset.order|0); });
      for(var i=0;i<ss.length;i++){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        var b  = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'yh-m-row';
        b.dataset.mega = 'mega-diensten';
        b.dataset.sec  = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        b.innerHTML = '<i class="yh-m-rowicon fa-regular ' + ss[i].dataset.icon + '"></i><span class="yh-m-rowlabel"></span><i class="fa-regular fa-chevron-right"></i>';
        b.querySelector('.yh-m-rowlabel').textContent = ss[i].dataset.sec;
        li.appendChild(b);
        menu.insertBefore(li, liDien);
        gen.push(li);
      }

      var cli = document.createElement('li');
      cli.appendChild(cart);
      menu.appendChild(cli);
      gen.push(cli);

      mRoot();
    }

    function toDesktop(){
      closeMobile();
      actions.appendChild(cart);
      for(var i=0;i<gen.length;i++){ if(gen[i].parentNode) gen[i].parentNode.removeChild(gen[i]); }
      gen = [];
      bar.insertBefore(menu, actions);
      actions.insertBefore(webmail, hamb);
      actions.insertBefore(login, hamb);
      wide.insertBefore(promo, wide.firstChild);
      nav.insertBefore(panels, scrim);
      mRoot();
    }

    function applyMode(){
      var m = MQ.matches ? 'm' : 'd';
      if(m === mode) return;
      mode = m;
      if(m === 'm') toMobile(); else toDesktop();
    }

    /* ---------- events ---------- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-mega]') : null;
      if(t){
        e.preventDefault();
        if(MQ.matches) mOpen(t.dataset.mega, t.dataset.sec);
        else openMega(t);
        return;
      }
      if(MQ.matches) return;
      if(e.target.closest('.yh-mega')) return;
      closeMega();
    });

    scrim.addEventListener('click', closeMega);
    hamb.addEventListener('click', openMobile);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobile);
    backBtn.addEventListener('click', mRoot);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      closeMega();
      if(mobile.classList.contains('open')) closeMobile();
    });

    if(MQ.addEventListener) MQ.addEventListener('change', applyMode);
    else if(MQ.addListener) MQ.addListener(applyMode);
    window.addEventListener('resize', applyMode);
    applyMode();
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  }else{
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
